findings.summary: The notification model exposes a priority field (defaults 'normal', can be 'urgent'/'high') but the card never surfaces it, unlike the sibling action-inbox and feed cards which render MobileStatusPill(item.priority) to flag urgent items.
findings.fix: In the subtitle Column, add a MobileStatusPill(item.priority) row (e.g. only when priority is not 'normal') so urgent/high notifications get the same colored pill treatment used across the action inbox and official feed, keeping the visual language consistent.

findings.summary: The trailing affordance uses Icons.chevron_left whereas nearly every other list/detail page (manager_home, executive_home, governance, operations, people, reports) uses Icons.chevron_left_rounded.
findings.fix: Change to `const Icon(Icons.chevron_left_rounded)` to match the rounded chevron used consistently in the rest of the app.

findings.summary: The empty-state uses a raw `TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)` with no color and a default-colored icon, so it does not read the onSurfaceVariant tone used for secondary/empty content elsewhere.
findings.fix: Give the empty-state icon and text an explicit muted color, e.g. `Icon(Icons.notifications_none, size: 48, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)` and add `color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant` to the title's copyWith style so the empty state matches the app's subdued treatment.

findings.summary: The error state renders only raw text inside a Card with no error icon or color emphasis, unlike a proper error affordance and inconsistent with the app's status-color palette.
findings.fix: Add a leading `Icon(Icons.error_outline, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error)` above/beside the message inside the error Card so failures are visually distinguishable from normal content.

findings.summary: The unread indicator dot (Positioned red circle) conveys 'unread' purely visually with no semantic label, so screen-reader users cannot tell read from unread.
findings.fix: Wrap the ListTile (or the leading Stack) in a Semantics widget with a label such as 'إشعار غير مقروء' when `!item.isRead`, so the unread status is announced.

findings.summary: The list separator uses SizedBox(height: 8) whereas the sibling notification-style lists (action inbox, official feed) use a 10px separator between cards, giving a slightly tighter rhythm than the rest of the app.
findings.fix: Change the separatorBuilder gap to `const SizedBox(height: 10)` to match the card spacing used in mobile_action_inbox_page and mobile_official_feed_page.
